text:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: autoscaler error in azure-southindia (ap-southindia). GPU pool scale-up failed due to quota limits. queue_length=1248, error_rate=18%. Paging #oncall.

ashish: seeing it. digging in. queue still climbing. first priority = stop customer-visible 503s.

amal: checking autoscaler logs now. logs show repeated 403/QuotaExceeded from Azure API when trying to create vmss for gpu-pool-apsouth. snippet:
```
2026-04-15T10:02:11Z ERROR: ComputeClient.CreateVMSS failed: code=QuotaExceeded msg="Quota limit 'Total Regional GPUs' exceeded for subscription"
attempts=6
```

kevin: confirmed customer impact: Dedicated customers in ap-southindia reporting high tail latency and intermittent 503s. Support dashboard shows 46 active errors in last 5m, p95 latency up from 140ms -> 2.1s for generation requests.

nina: starting draft comms for affected customers. tentative: "We're investigating increased errors for inference in ap-southindia; mitigation in progress; will update in 30m." want any technical detail in the first notice?

ashish: minimal detail first. say region degraded, failover in progress. link to status page once we have stable mitigation.

amal: quick mitigation options list:
- evict low-priority/best-effort workloads (model-training-batch) from ap-southindia
- reduce concurrency per-GPU by enabling smaller batch sizes for some model routes
- promote quantized model variants to reduce memory footprint / fit more replicas
- reroute new traffic for customers with geo-flex routing to us-west2 temporarily

ashish: executing now: 1) added eviction label to batch workloads, 2) triggered route override for geo-flexible customers (config snippet):
```
POST /api/v1/routing/override
{ "region": "ap-southindia", "fallback": "us-west2", "match": "customer_tags:geo-flex" }
```

cloud-ops: opened Azure support ticket 2026-AP-SOUTH-789. referencing quota request. Azure initial reply: "Quota increase request received; expected review within 24-48 hours. Temporary quota extensions require manual approval and are not guaranteed." recommend failover until quota is granted.

kevin: spinning up failover capacity in us-west2. note: cold start latency will be higher for some customers. also enabling prefix/KV cache warming to reduce token regen load.

ashish: also dropping non-critical batch job shards with command:
```
kubectl label nodes -l pool=batch evict-now=true --overwrite
```

amal: enabled smaller batch size on heavy routes:
```
PATCH /api/v1/models/<redwood/large-gen>/config
{ "batch_size": 4 }
```
immediate memory reduction per-replica ~22%.

nina: first customer notice sent to 12 accounts. keeping it short. will post status update in 30m. :email:

sre-lead: good call on failover. please capture timeline and decisions in the incident doc after this thread. escalation path for quota increases: cloud-ops -> sales-enterprise -> Azure TAM if SLA customer.

ashish: handing off to @kevin for next 2h window. I'll stay on-call overlap for 15m and then move to monitoring only. kevin, you own comms and next steps.

kevin: got it. summary for handoff:
- root cause: regional GPU quota exhausted, autoscaler failing with quota errors
- immediate mitigations: evicted batch jobs, reduced batch sizes, promoted quantized variants, started failover to us-west2
- cloud-ops opened ticket 2026-AP-SOUTH-789
- customer impact: elevated error rate (~18%), increased p95 latency; some 503s for dedicated customers
- next actions: monitor queue until <200, continue traffic reroute, await Azure update or provisioned preemptible fallback

ashish: current metrics: queue=420 (was 1248), error_rate=3.7%, p95=210ms. progress. :white_check_mark:

kevin: continuing. will update every 10m or on major change. prepping a follow-up customer note for when we hit queue <300.

incidents-bot: runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gpu-quota-failover. remember to fill in incident doc template.

cloud-ops: Azure update: "We can provision a temporary quota increase but need approval from subscription owner; ETA 2-4h after approval." recommending customers with strict SLAs escalate via TAM.

nina: prepping a 'we degraded, now stabilizing' update to send in 45m unless things change.

amal: note for postmortem: consider auto-failover threshold when regional quota errors are detected; autoscaler should mark region unhealthy and fail traffic sooner.

kevin: accepted. adding to action items.

ashish: leaving the channel for now, monitoring via alerts. thanks team.

kevin: acknowledged. taking over. logging this thread into incidents/312-2026-ap-southindia-gpu-quota in the incident tracker.

nina: update sent: "Issue identified as GPU quota exhaustion in ap-southindia. Failover and mitigations underway. We will provide technical follow-up once fully resolved."
